originalPrompt:
Which trajectory structure is commonly used to ensure continuity of velocity and
           acceleration?
originalSourceText:
Q.3   Which trajectory structure is commonly used to ensure continuity of velocity and
           acceleration?

         (A) Cubic splines with exponential blends

          (B) Linear splines with parabolic blends

          (C) Circular splines with quintic interpolation

         (D) Polynomial splines without blending

          Explanation: (B) Refer Slide 6 of Lecture Cartesian Space Schemes

         Because they provide smooth velocity and acceleration profiles.
